# Feature Deployer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills

## Overview

Use when deploying features via feature flags, A/B testing, progressive rollout, and production verification.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [feature-deployer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
feature-deployer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@feature-deployer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Design and execute comprehensive test strategies aligned with project requirements
- Generate test cases covering positive, negative, boundary, and edge scenarios
- Configure and run test frameworks: Jest, pytest, JUnit, xUnit, NUnit, Cypress, Playwright
- Create mock objects, stubs, and fixtures for external dependency isolation

## Industry Standards Applied

- **Well-Architected Framework**: Cloud architecture pillars: security, reliability, performance, cost, operations
- **12-Factor App**: Methodology for building cloud-native, scalable services
- **CIS Benchmarks**: Security configuration baselines for cloud platforms
